class ForegroundServicePermissionDetector : Detector(), XmlScanner {

    companion object {
        val ISSUE = Issue.create(
            id = "ForegroundServicePermission",
            briefDescription = "Missing permissions required by foregroundServiceType",
            explanation = """
                For targetSdkVersion 34 and above, each foregroundServiceType declared on a \
                <service> element requires a corresponding permission to be declared in the \
                manifest. Missing permissions cause a SecurityException when the service is \
                started.
            """.trimIndent(),
            category = Category.CORRECTNESS,
            priority = 6,
            severity = Severity.ERROR,
            implementation = Implementation(
                ForegroundServicePermissionDetector::class.java,
                Scope.MANIFEST_SCOPE
            )
        )

        private const val ANDROID_NS = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
        private const val TAG_SERVICE = "service"
        private const val ATTR_FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE = "foregroundServiceType"
        private const val TAG_USES_PERMISSION = "uses-permission"
        private const val TAG_USES_SDK = "uses-sdk"
        private const val ATTR_TARGET_SDK_VERSION = "targetSdkVersion"
        private const val ATTR_NAME = "name"

        // Map type to required permission(s). For alternatives, list any acceptable permission.
        private val REQUIRED_PERMISSIONS = mapOf(
            "camera" to listOf("android.permission.CAMERA"),
            "connectedDevice" to listOf(
                "android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT",
                "android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN",
                "android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE",
                "android.permission.UWB_RANGING"
            ),
            "dataSync" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC"),
            "health" to listOf(
                "android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_HEALTH",
                "android.permission.HIGH_SAMPLING_RATE_SENSORS"
            ),
            "location" to listOf(
                "android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION",
                "android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION"
            ),
            "mediaPlayback" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK"),
            "mediaProjection" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION"),
            "microphone" to listOf("android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO"),
            "phoneCall" to listOf(
                "android.permission.CALL_PHONE",
                "android.permission.MANAGE_OWN_CALLS"
            ),
            "remoteMessaging" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_REMOTE_MESSAGING"),
            "shortService" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SHORT_SERVICE"),
            "specialUse" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE"),
            "systemExempted" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SYSTEM_EXEMPTED")
        )
    }

    override fun getApplicableElements(): Collection<String> = listOf(TAG_SERVICE)

    override fun visitElement(context: XmlContext, element: Element) {
        if (!isTargetSdk34OrHigher(context.document)) return
        val attr = element.getAttributeNS(ANDROID_NS, ATTR_FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE) ?: return
        if (attr.isBlank()) return
        val declaredPermissions = getDeclaredPermissions(context.document)
        val types = attr.split('|').map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        for (type in types) {
            val required = REQUIRED_PERMISSIONS[type] ?: continue
            if (required.none { it in declaredPermissions }) {
                val message = buildString {
                    append("Missing permission for foregroundServiceType \"$type\": ")
                    append(
                        if (required.size == 1) "declare `${required[0]}`"
                        else "declare one of ${required.joinToString(", ") { "`$it`" }}"
                    )
                }
                context.report(
                    ISSUE,
                    element,
                    context.getLocation(element.getAttributeNodeNS(ANDROID_NS, ATTR_FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE) ?: element),
                    message
                )
            }
        }
    }

    private fun isTargetSdk34OrHigher(document: Document): Boolean {
        val usesSdk = document.getElementsByTagName(TAG_USES_SDK)
        for (i in 0 until usesSdk.length) {
            val node = usesSdk.item(i) as? Element ?: continue
            val targetSdk = node.getAttributeNS(ANDROID_NS, ATTR_TARGET_SDK_VERSION)
            if (targetSdk.isNotBlank()) {
                return targetSdk.toIntOrNull() ?: 0 >= 34
            }
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun getDeclaredPermissions(document: Document): Set<String> {
        val result = mutableSetOf<String>()
        val permissions = document.getElementsByTagName(TAG_USES_PERMISSION)
        for (i in 0 until permissions.length) {
            val node = permissions.item(i) as? Element ?: continue
            val name = node.getAttributeNS(ANDROID_NS, ATTR_NAME)
            if (name.isNotBlank()) result.add(name)
        }
        return result
    }
}

package com.android.tools.lint.checks

import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.Category
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.Detector
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.Implementation
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.Issue
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.Scope
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.Severity
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.XmlContext
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.XmlScanner
import org.w3c.dom.Attr
import org.w3c.dom.Document
import org.w3c.dom.Element

class ForegroundServicePermissionDetector : Detector(), XmlScanner {

    override fun getApplicableElements(): Collection<String> = listOf(TAG_SERVICE)

    override fun visitElement(context: XmlContext, element: Element) {
        if (!isTargetSdk34OrHigher(context)) {
            return
        }

        val attrNode = element.getAttributeNodeNS(ANDROID_NS, ATTR_FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE)
        val value = attrNode?.value ?: element.getAttributeNS(ANDROID_NS, ATTR_FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE)
        if (value.isBlank()) {
            return
        }

        val declaredPermissions = getDeclaredPermissions(context.document)
        val types = value.split('|').map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }

        for (type in types) {
            val required = REQUIRED_PERMISSIONS[type] ?: continue
            if (required.none { it in declaredPermissions }) {
                val message = if (required.size == 1) {
                    "Missing permission required for foregroundServiceType \"$type\": declare `${required[0]}` in the manifest."
                } else {
                    "Missing permission required for foregroundServiceType \"$type\": declare one of ${required.joinToString { "`$it`" }} in the manifest."
                }
                context.report(
                    ISSUE,
                    element,
                    context.getLocation(attrNode ?: element),
                    message
                )
            }
        }
    }

    private fun isTargetSdk34OrHigher(context: XmlContext): Boolean {
        if (context.project.targetSdk >= 34) {
            return true
        }

        val usesSdk = context.document.getElementsByTagName(TAG_USES_SDK)
        for (i in 0 until usesSdk.length) {
            val node = usesSdk.item(i) as? Element ?: continue
            val targetSdk = node.getAttributeNS(ANDROID_NS, ATTR_TARGET_SDK_VERSION)
            if (targetSdk.isNotBlank()) {
                return (targetSdk.toIntOrNull() ?: 0) >= 34
            }
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun getDeclaredPermissions(document: Document): Set<String> {
        val permissions = mutableSetOf<String>()
        val nodes = document.getElementsByTagName(TAG_USES_PERMISSION)
        for (i in 0 until nodes.length) {
            val node = nodes.item(i) as? Element ?: continue
            val name = node.getAttributeNS(ANDROID_NS, ATTR_NAME)
            if (name.isNotBlank()) {
                permissions.add(name)
            }
        }
        return permissions
    }

    companion object {
        @JvmField
        val ISSUE = Issue.create(
            id = "ForegroundServicePermission",
            briefDescription = "Missing permission required by foregroundServiceType",
            explanation = """
                Starting with targetSdkVersion 34, each foregroundServiceType declared on a \
                <service> element requires a corresponding permission to be declared in the \
                manifest. If the required permission is missing, the system throws a \
                SecurityException when the service is started with that type.
            """.trimIndent(),
            category = Category.CORRECTNESS,
            priority = 6,
            severity = Severity.ERROR,
            implementation = Implementation(
                ForegroundServicePermissionDetector::class.java,
                Scope.MANIFEST_SCOPE
            )
        )

        private const val ANDROID_NS = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
        private const val TAG_SERVICE = "service"
        private const val TAG_USES_PERMISSION = "uses-permission"
        private const val TAG_USES_SDK = "uses-sdk"
        private const val ATTR_FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE = "foregroundServiceType"
        private const val ATTR_TARGET_SDK_VERSION = "targetSdkVersion"
        private const val ATTR_NAME = "name"

        private val REQUIRED_PERMISSIONS = mapOf(
            "camera" to listOf("android.permission.CAMERA"),
            "connectedDevice" to listOf(
                "android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT",
                "android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN",
                "android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE",
                "android.permission.UWB_RANGING"
            ),
            "dataSync" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC"),
            "health" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_HEALTH"),
            "location" to listOf(
                "android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION",
                "android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION"
            ),
            "mediaPlayback" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK"),
            "mediaProjection" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION"),
            "microphone" to listOf("android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO"),
            "phoneCall" to listOf(
                "android.permission.CALL_PHONE",
                "android.permission.MANAGE_OWN_CALLS"
            ),
            "remoteMessaging" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_REMOTE_MESSAGING"),
            "shortService" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SHORT_SERVICE"),
            "specialUse" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE"),
            "systemExempted" to listOf("android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SYSTEM_EXEMPTED")
        )
    }
}
